span.p:
agent_loop.invoke(tool, args, actor) — THE ONE CHOKEPOINT
HUMAN_VERBS refuse actor != 'reviewer'; AGENT_TOOLS refuse actor != 'agent'.
Every box below that says invoke(...) lands here; there is no second path.
The review page's Approve button calls it exactly as the agent's tools do.

span.p:
Human review queue.
process_capture is a NO-OP once state == 'escalated':
nothing advances this capture until a person calls
invoke(verb, args, actor='reviewer'). That is the whole
mechanism behind 'waits for human approval'.

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
approve — refuses a suspected_duplicate
until resolve_duplicate has run

color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
THE QUALIFYING BEAT — visual evidence changes what the system does next.
glare_text.jpg fires rule 6, glare_over_total (glare_over_text_frac).
The retake removes the glare but crops the page, so the NEXT capture fires
rule 5, bottom_edge_clipped (edge_touch_sides) — a DIFFERENT rule, chosen by a
DIFFERENT metric, on a DIFFERENT image. Asserted end to end by tools/run_demo.py
and measured as the retake-convergence set in docs/evaluation.md.

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Trace ribbon — every invoke() records TraceEntry(seq, actor, action, inputs, outputs, caused_by).
trace_chain() walks parent_id back to the root capture and renumbers seq across the whole chain,
so caused_by points at the node that produced each decision.

div.style: color: rgb(68, 68, 68) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Callout A — code_decoded == false is a CLAUSE of rule 7:
a decoded QR cancels the retake a soft-focus page would otherwise get.
A measurement can call OFF an action, not only call one.

div.style: color: rgb(68, 68, 68) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Callout B — attempt >= 3 fires rule 4, persistent_defect (escalate):
after two retakes the agent stops guessing and asks a person.

div.style: color: rgb(68, 68, 68) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
LEGEND — solid box or solid edge = built and exercised by tests.
Dashed box or dashed edge = planned, not built; override, discard and close_batch
are named unbuilt in agent_loop.py's own docstring.
Drawn AS BUILT; agent-workflow.md records where this diverges from SPEC § 16B.
